text_en: Paul , a prisoner of Christ Jesus , and Timothy, a brother: to Philemon, our beloved and fellow labourer,
text_la: Paulus vinctus Christi Jesu, et Timotheus frater, Philemoni dilecto, et adjutori nostro,
text_pt: Paulo, prisioneiro de Jesus Cristo, e o irmão Timóteo, ao amado Filemom, nosso cooperador,
text_el: Παῦλος δέσμιος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ καὶ Τιμόθεος ὁ ἀδελφὸς Φιλήμονι τῷ ἀγαπητῷ καὶ συνεργῷ ἡμῶν

text_en: and to Appia, our dearest sister, and to Archippus, our fellow soldier, and to the church which is in your house.
text_la: et Appiæ sorori carissimæ, et Archippo commilitoni nostro, et ecclesiæ, quæ in domo tua est.
text_pt: E à nossa amada Áfia, e a Arquipo, nosso camarada, e à igreja que está em tua casa:
text_el: καὶ Ἀπφίᾳ τῇ ἀδελφῇ καὶ Ἀρχίππῳ τῷ συστρατιώτῃ ἡμῶν καὶ τῇ κατ' οἶκόν σου ἐκκλησίᾳ:

text_en: Grace to you and peace, from God our Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ .
text_la: Gratia vobis, et pax a Deo Patre nostro, et Domino Jesu Christo.
text_pt: Graça a vós e paz da parte de Deus nosso Pai, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo.
text_el: χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν καὶ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

text_en: I give thanks to my God , always making a remembrance of you in my prayers .
text_la: Gratias ago Deo meo, semper memoriam tui faciens in orationibus meis,
text_pt: Graças dou ao meu Deus, lembrando-me sempre de ti nas minhas orações;
text_el: Εὐχαριστῶ τῷ θεῷ μου πάντοτε μνείαν σου ποιούμενος ἐπὶ τῶν προσευχῶν μου,

text_en: Hearing of your charity and faith , which you have in the Lord Jesus and towards all the saints :
text_la: audiens caritatem tuam, et fidem, quam habes in Domino Jesu, et in omnes sanctos:
text_pt: Ouvindo do teu amor e da fé que tens para com o Senhor Jesus Cristo, e para com todos os santos;
text_el: ἀκούων σου τὴν ἀγάπην καὶ τὴν πίστιν ἣν ἔχεις εἰς τὸν κύριον Ἰησοῦν καὶ εἰς πάντας τοὺς ἁγίους,

text_en: That the communication of your faith may be made evident in the acknowledgment of every good work that is in you in Christ Jesus .
text_la: ut communicatio fidei tuæ evidens fiat in agnitione omnis operis boni, quod est in vobis in Christo Jesu.
text_pt: Para que a comunicação da tua fé seja eficaz no conhecimento de todo o bem que em vós há por Cristo Jesus.
text_el: ὅπως ἡ κοινωνία τῆς πίστεώς σου ἐνεργὴς γένηται ἐν ἐπιγνώσει παντὸς ἀγαθοῦ [τοῦ] ἐν ἡμῖν εἰς Χριστόν:

text_en: For I have had great joy and consolation in your charity , because the bowels of the saints have been refreshed by you, brother.
text_la: Gaudium enim magnum habui, et consolationem in caritate tua : quia viscera sanctorum requieverunt per te, frater.
text_pt: Porque temos grande gozo e consolação do teu amor, porque por ti, ó irmão, as entranhas dos santos foram recreadas.
text_el: χαρὰν γὰρ πολλὴν ἔσχον καὶ παράκλησιν ἐπὶ τῇ ἀγάπῃ σου, ὅτι τὰ σπλάγχνα τῶν ἁγίων ἀναπέπαυται διὰ σοῦ, ἀδελφέ.

text_en: Wherefore, though I have much confidence in Christ Jesus to command you that which is to the purpose:
text_la: Propter quod multam fiduciam habens in Christo Jesu imperandi tibi quod ad rem pertinet:
text_pt: Por isso, ainda que tenha em Cristo grande confiança para te mandar o que te convém,
text_el: διό, πολλὴν ἐν Χριστῷ παρρησίαν ἔχων ἐπιτάσσειν σοι τὸ ἀνῆκον,

text_en: For charity sake I rather beseech, whereas you are such a one, as Paul , an old man and now a prisoner also of Jesus Christ .
text_la: propter caritatem magis obsecro, cum sis talis, ut Paulus senex, nunc autem et vinctus Jesu Christi:
text_pt: Todavia peço-te antes por amor, sendo eu tal como sou, Paulo o velho, e também agora prisioneiro de Jesus Cristo.
text_el: διὰ τὴν ἀγάπην μᾶλλον παρακαλῶ, τοιοῦτος ὢν ὡς Παῦλος πρεσβύτης, νυνὶ δὲ καὶ δέσμιος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ,

text_en: I beseech you for my son, whom I have begotten in my bands, Onesimus,
text_la: obsecro te pro meo filio, quem genui in vinculis, Onesimo,
text_pt: Peço-te por meu filho Onésimo, que gerei nas minhas prisões;
text_el: παρακαλῶ σε περὶ τοῦ ἐμοῦ τέκνου, ὃν ἐγέννησα ἐν τοῖς δεσμοῖς, Ὀνήσιμον,

text_en: who has been heretofore unprofitable to you but now is profitable both to me and you:
text_la: qui tibi aliquando inutilis fuit, nunc autem et mihi et tibi utilis,
text_pt: O qual noutro tempo te foi inútil, mas agora a ti e a mim muito útil; eu to tornei a enviar.
text_el: τόν ποτέ σοι ἄχρηστον νυνὶ δὲ σοὶ καὶ ἐμοὶ εὔχρηστον,

text_en: Whom I have sent back to you. And receive him as my own bowels.
text_la: quem remisi tibi. Tu autem illum, ut mea viscera, suscipe:
text_pt: E tu torna a recebê-lo como às minhas entranhas.
text_el: ὃν ἀνέπεμψά σοι, αὐτόν, τοῦτ' ἔστιν τὰ ἐμὰ σπλάγχνα.

text_en: Whom I would have retained with me, that in your stead he might have ministered to me in the bands of the gospel .
text_la: quem ego volueram mecum detinere, ut pro te mihi ministraret in vinculis Evangelii:
text_pt: Eu bem o quisera conservar comigo, para que por ti me servisse nas prisões do evangelho;
text_el: ὃν ἐγὼ ἐβουλόμην πρὸς ἐμαυτὸν κατέχειν, ἵνα ὑπὲρ σοῦ μοι διακονῇ ἐν τοῖς δεσμοῖς τοῦ εὐαγγελίου,

text_en: But without your counsel I would do nothing: that your good deed might not be as it were of necessity, but voluntary.
text_la: sine consilio autem tuo nihil volui facere, uti ne velut ex necessitate bonum tuum esset, sed voluntarium.
text_pt: Mas nada quis fazer sem o teu parecer, para que o teu benefício não fosse como por força, mas, voluntário.
text_el: χωρὶς δὲ τῆς σῆς γνώμης οὐδὲν ἠθέλησα ποιῆσαι, ἵνα μὴ ὡς κατὰ ἀνάγκην τὸ ἀγαθόν σου ᾖ ἀλλὰ κατὰ ἑκούσιον.

text_en: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season from you that you might receive him again for ever:
text_la: Forsitan enim ideo discessit ad horam a te, ut æternum illum reciperes:
text_pt: Porque bem pode ser que ele se tenha separado de ti por algum tempo, para que o retivesses para sempre,
text_el: τάχα γὰρ διὰ τοῦτο ἐχωρίσθη πρὸς ὥραν ἵνα αἰώνιον αὐτὸν ἀπέχῃς,

text_en: Not now as a servant, but instead of a servant, a most dear brother, especially to me. But how much more to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord?
text_la: jam non ut servum, sed pro servo carissimum fratrem, maxime mihi : quanto autem magis tibi et in carne, et in Domino?
text_pt: Não já como servo, antes, mais do que servo, como irmão amado, particularmente de mim, e quanto mais de ti, assim na carne como no Senhor?
text_el: οὐκέτι ὡς δοῦλον ἀλλ' ὑπὲρ δοῦλον, ἀδελφὸν ἀγαπητόν, μάλιστα ἐμοί, πόσῳ δὲ μᾶλλον σοὶ καὶ ἐν σαρκὶ καὶ ἐν κυρίῳ.

text_en: If therefore you count me a partner, receive him as myself.
text_la: Si ergo habes me socium, suscipe illum sicut me:
text_pt: Assim, pois, se me tens por companheiro, recebe-o como a mim mesmo.
text_el: εἰ οὖν με ἔχεις κοινωνόν, προσλαβοῦ αὐτὸν ὡς ἐμέ.

text_en: And if he has wronged you in anything or is in your debt, put that to my account.
text_la: si autem aliquid nocuit tibi, aut debet, hoc mihi imputa.
text_pt: E, se te fez algum dano, ou te deve alguma coisa, põe isso à minha conta.
text_el: εἰ δέ τι ἠδίκησέν σε ἢ ὀφείλει, τοῦτο ἐμοὶ ἐλλόγα:

text_en: I Paul have written it with my own hand: I will repay it: not to say to you that you owe me your own self also.
text_la: Ego Paulus scripsi mea manu : ego reddam, ut non dicam tibi, quod et teipsum mihi debes:
text_pt: Eu, Paulo, de minha própria mão o escrevi; eu o pagarei, para te não dizer que ainda mesmo a ti próprio a mim te deves.
text_el: ἐγὼ Παῦλος ἔγραψα τῇ ἐμῇ χειρί, ἐγὼ ἀποτίσω: ἵνα μὴ λέγω σοι ὅτι καὶ σεαυτόν μοι προσοφείλεις.

text_en: Yea, brother. May I enjoy you in the Lord! Refresh my bowels in the Lord.
text_la: ita, frater. Ego te fruar in Domino : refice viscera mea in Domino.
text_pt: Sim, irmão, eu me regozijarei de ti no Senhor; recreia as minhas entranhas no Senhor.
text_el: ναί, ἀδελφέ, ἐγώ σου ὀναίμην ἐν κυρίῳ: ἀνάπαυσόν μου τὰ σπλάγχνα ἐν Χριστῷ.

text_en: Trusting in your obedience , I have written to you: knowing that you will also do more than I say.
text_la: Confidens in obedientia tua scripsi tibi : sciens quoniam et super id, quod dico, facies.
text_pt: Escrevi-te confiado na tua obediência, sabendo que ainda farás mais do que digo.
text_el: Πεποιθὼς τῇ ὑπακοῇ σου ἔγραψά σοι, εἰδὼς ὅτι καὶ ὑπὲρ ἃ λέγω ποιήσεις.

text_en: But withal prepare me also a lodging. For I hope that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.
text_la: Simul autem et para mihi hospitium : nam spero per orationes vestras donari me vobis.
text_pt: E juntamente prepara-me também pousada, porque espero que pelas vossas orações vos hei de ser concedido.
text_el: ἅμα δὲ καὶ ἑτοίμαζέ μοι ξενίαν: ἐλπίζω γὰρ ὅτι διὰ τῶν προσευχῶν ὑμῶν χαρισθήσομαι ὑμῖν.

text_en: There salute you Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus :
text_la: Salutat te Epaphras concaptivus meus in Christo Jesu,
text_pt: Saúdam-te Epafras, meu companheiro de prisão por Cristo Jesus,
text_el: Ἀσπάζεταί σε Ἐπαφρᾶς ὁ συναιχμάλωτός μου ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ,

text_en: Mark , Aristarchus, Demas and Luke, my fellow labourers.
text_la: Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas, et Lucas, adjutores mei.
text_pt: Marcos, Aristarco, Demas e Lucas, meus cooperadores.
text_el: Μᾶρκος, Ἀρίσταρχος, Δημᾶς, Λουκᾶς, οἱ συνεργοί μου.

text_en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen .
text_la: Gratia Domini nostri Jesu Christi cum spiritu vestro. Amen.
text_pt: A graça de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo seja com o vosso espírito. Amém.
text_el: Ἡ χάρις τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μετὰ τοῦ πνεύματος ὑμῶν.
